title: gpt-oss-120b & gpt-oss-20b Model Card
paper_type_zh: 前沿开源权重模型卡与数据披露台账
best_for_zh: 需要辨析开放模型发布与未公开后训练数据、反馈机制及审计证据边界的读者
one_line: gpt-oss discloses broad pretraining, CoT-RL/tool interfaces, safety mitigation, and Apache-2.0 weights/tool references while withholding source-level training, reward, rollout, and audit artifacts.
gpt-oss 披露了概括性的预训练、CoT-RL/工具接口、安全缓解措施以及 Apache-2.0 权重与工具参考实现，但未公开按来源划分的训练数据、奖励、rollout 或审计工件。
why: It distinguishes a real open-weight inference release from an unreleased post-training pipeline whose data provenance, reasoning traces, reward contract, and contamination evidence cannot be audited.
inclusion_reason: Official OpenAI model card for open-weight reasoning models with concrete data-domain, CoT/tool-interface, safety, release, and risk disclosures alongside substantial opacity in training artifacts.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Frontier model reports can make post-training behavior legible while leaving the provenance, construction, and auditability of the underlying data and feedback objects incomplete. For reasoning models, an open-weight release must not be conflated with an open training recipe: source records, accepted and rejected traces, reward calibration, verifier coverage, and contamination controls may remain unavailable.

gpt-oss is valuable for this distinction. Its official Model Card and release describe two open-weight reasoning models, their tool-facing conversation interface, and several training and safety choices, while withholding the material needed to reconstruct or audit the post-training data pipeline. This Card records that boundary as a Track 12 disclosure ledger; it does not treat the release as a reusable RLVR recipe.

前沿模型报告可以说明后训练后的行为，却仍可能没有完整披露底层数据和反馈对象的来源、构造过程与可审计性。对推理模型而言，开放权重发布不能等同于开放训练配方：源记录、保留和拒绝的轨迹、奖励校准、verifier 覆盖范围与污染控制都可能仍不可得。

gpt-oss 对这一界线很有参考价值。其官方 Model Card 与发布页说明了两个开放权重推理模型、面向工具的对话接口，以及若干训练和安全做法；但重建或审计后训练数据流水线所需的实质性材料仍未公开。本 Card 将该边界记录为 Track 12 的披露台账，而不把这一发布当作可复用的 RLVR 配方。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The official record presents gpt-oss-120b and gpt-oss-20b as mixture-of-experts reasoning models trained with large-scale distillation and reinforcement learning. Its most reusable disclosure is an interface-level description: Harmony conversations distinguish System, Developer, User, Assistant, and Tool roles, with separate analysis, commentary, and final channels, and the public release includes reference inference and tool environments.

The Card's central interpretation is deliberately narrower than a model-performance claim. The report exposes enough to identify possible post-training data objects—conversation turns, reasoning text, tool calls, tool observations, and final responses—but it does not release the corresponding prompts, traces, rewards, filters, or provenance. The object of study is therefore the disclosure boundary itself.

官方记录将 gpt-oss-120b 和 gpt-oss-20b 描述为使用大规模蒸馏与强化学习训练的 mixture-of-experts 推理模型。它最可复用的披露属于接口层：Harmony 对话区分 System、Developer、User、Assistant 和 Tool 角色，并使用彼此分离的 analysis、commentary 与 final 通道；公开发布还包含参考推理实现和工具环境。

本 Card 的核心解读刻意比模型性能结论更窄。报告已足以识别可能的后训练数据对象——对话轮次、推理文本、工具调用、工具观测和最终回答——但没有发布相应的 prompts、轨迹、奖励、过滤规则或来源。因此，本条目的研究对象是披露边界本身。

title: Method
方法
html:
The report says that pre-training uses a mostly English, text-only mixture focused on STEM, coding, and general knowledge. It reports CBRN-related harmful-data filtering with GPT-4o CBRN filters, but does not publish a source manifest, source proportions, item-level provenance, rights records, or a complete filtering specification.

For post-training, the report describes supervised fine-tuning followed by high-compute chain-of-thought reinforcement learning, using techniques similar to o4-mini and o3, together with large-scale distillation. It names low, medium, and high reasoning-effort behavior and reports support for browsing, stateful Python/Jupyter use, and developer-provided functions. The Harmony format represents analysis reasoning, commentary tool interaction, and final responses. Exact training environments, teachers, prompts, rollouts, sampling settings, reward functions, verifier implementations, filtering yields, and optimization configuration are not disclosed.

Safety work includes deliberative alignment and instruction hierarchy. An adversarially fine-tuned gpt-oss-120b variant is discussed for biology and cybersecurity preparedness evaluations, but the associated safety data, human guidance, reward or selection process, and evaluation records are not released as a reusable dataset or environment.

报告称，预训练使用以英语为主的纯文本混合数据，重点覆盖 STEM、代码和通用知识。它报告了使用 GPT-4o CBRN filters 过滤与 CBRN 相关的有害预训练数据，但未公布来源清单、各来源占比、样本级来源、权利记录或完整过滤规范。

对于后训练，报告描述了先进行监督微调、再进行高计算量 chain-of-thought 强化学习，并采用与 o4-mini 和 o3 类似的技术以及大规模蒸馏。它说明了 low、medium、high 三种 reasoning effort 行为，并报告支持浏览、在 Jupyter 环境中使用有状态 Python，以及开发者提供的函数。Harmony 格式表示 analysis 推理、commentary 工具交互和 final 回答。精确训练环境、教师模型、prompts、rollouts、采样设置、奖励函数、verifier 实现、过滤保留率和优化配置均未披露。

安全工作包括 deliberative alignment 和 instruction hierarchy。报告讨论了为生物与网络安全 preparedness 评估而对抗式微调的 gpt-oss-120b 变体，但相关安全数据、人工指导、奖励或选择过程以及评估记录没有作为可复用数据集或环境发布。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The official release states that gpt-oss-120b has 117B total parameters with 5.1B active parameters per token, and gpt-oss-20b has 21B total parameters with 3.6B active parameters per token. It also states that the models, tokenizer, inference implementations, and tool environments are released under Apache 2.0. The official repository provides the reference implementation and the official Hugging Face organization hosts model releases.

The Model Card and release describe evaluations in mathematics, coding, safety, and agentic tool use, including browsing and Python. These are reported evaluation results and capability descriptions, not independent evidence that the stated post-training data, reward contract, or safety procedure can be reproduced. In particular, the release does not provide a training-data package, feedback dataset, reward/verifier artifact, split, decontamination report, or rollout log.

官方发布称，gpt-oss-120b 具有 117B 总参数、每 token 5.1B 活跃参数；gpt-oss-20b 具有 21B 总参数、每 token 3.6B 活跃参数。发布还称模型、tokenizer、推理实现和工具环境均以 Apache 2.0 公开。官方仓库提供参考实现，官方 Hugging Face 组织托管模型发布。

Model Card 与发布页描述了数学、代码、安全和 agentic tool use 的评估，其中包括浏览和 Python。这些内容是报告的评估结果和能力描述，并不是后训练数据、奖励约定或安全流程可以被复现的独立证据。特别是，该发布没有提供训练数据包、反馈数据集、reward/verifier 工件、数据划分、去污染报告或 rollout 日志。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
For this atlas, the distinctive contribution is not that gpt-oss makes a fully specified training-data release. Rather, it combines an open-weight model release with an unusually concrete public interface for reasoning and tools, a broad account of post-training and safety stages, and explicit model-card discussion of risks. That combination makes it possible to map what is disclosed and what remains opaque.

The report should not be read as evidence that its reinforcement-learning or distillation pipeline is transferable. Reward definitions, verifier coverage and error rates, trajectory selection, provenance, safety-data construction, and contamination controls are all material to such a claim and remain unavailable. The novelty recorded here is disclosure value, not a claim of reproducible methodology.

对本图谱而言，gpt-oss 的特殊价值不在于它发布了完整指定的训练数据，而在于它把开放权重模型发布、具体的推理与工具公开接口、对后训练和安全阶段的概括说明，以及 Model Card 中明确的风险讨论结合起来。这种组合使读者可以映射哪些内容已披露、哪些内容仍不透明。

不应把报告理解为其强化学习或蒸馏流水线可迁移的证据。奖励定义、verifier 覆盖范围和错误率、轨迹选择、来源、安全数据构造和污染控制都是作出这类判断的重要材料，而它们仍不可得。这里记录的创新性是披露价值，而非可复现方法论的主张。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The underlying pre-training, SFT, reinforcement-learning, distillation, safety, and tool-trajectory records are not released. Source names, mixture weights, data rights, per-stage counts, prompts, decoding settings, filtering thresholds and yields, teachers, rollout counts, optimizer details, reward functions, verifier implementations, and calibration measurements are absent or incomplete.

The release reports that unfiltered chain of thought can contain hallucinated or safety-inconsistent reasoning and advises against exposing it raw. It also reports that gpt-oss can hallucinate more than o4-mini without browsing, has weaker instruction-hierarchy resistance than o4-mini, and can have safety refusals weakened by downstream fine-tuning. The reported safety mitigations and evaluations do not substitute for release of the associated training/evaluation data or an independently auditable protocol.

Apache-2.0 availability of weights and reference tools does not establish rights to, provenance of, or reproducibility for the undisclosed training and feedback data. This is therefore a partial report-level disclosure record.

底层预训练、SFT、强化学习、蒸馏、安全和工具轨迹记录均未发布。来源名称、混合权重、数据权利、各阶段数量、prompts、解码设置、过滤阈值和保留率、教师模型、rollout 数、优化器细节、奖励函数、verifier 实现和校准测量均缺失或不完整。

发布报告称，未经筛选的 chain of thought 可能含有幻觉或与安全策略不一致的推理，并建议不要原样展示。它还报告了在不浏览时 gpt-oss 的幻觉可能多于 o4-mini、instruction-hierarchy 抵抗能力弱于 o4-mini，以及下游微调可能削弱安全拒答。报告中的安全缓解措施和评估不能替代相关训练/评估数据或可独立审计的协议。

权重和参考工具的 Apache-2.0 可用性并不证明未公开训练与反馈数据的权利、来源或可复现性。因此，本条目只是部分的、报告级披露记录。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
This Card helps readers audit a frontier open-weight release without confusing it with a released reasoning-data resource. It gives a concrete schema for separating public inference artifacts—weights, tokenizer, reference code, Harmony format, and reference tool environments—from unreleased construction artifacts—training prompts, traces, rewards, verifiers, data lineage, and audit logs.

It is useful for comparative disclosure studies, for assessing what can and cannot be reused in post-training research, and for designing future release checklists. Reusers may inspect the public tool and conversation interfaces, but must not infer a training recipe, a calibrated verifier, a licensed dataset, or contamination-safe evaluation from those artifacts.

本 Card 帮助读者审计一个前沿开放权重发布，同时不把它误认为已发布的推理数据资源。它给出了一套具体框架，用于区分公开的推理工件——权重、tokenizer、参考代码、Harmony 格式和参考工具环境——与未公开的构造工件——训练 prompts、轨迹、奖励、verifiers、数据谱系和审计日志。

它适用于比较披露研究、评估后训练研究中哪些内容可以或不可以复用，以及设计未来发布清单。复用者可以检查公开工具和对话接口，但不得从这些工件推断出训练配方、校准过的 verifier、具有明确许可的数据集或抗污染的评估。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Treat the model card as a disclosure source: it establishes broad training stages and interfaces, not an open post-training corpus or reward recipe.
  • Separate Apache-2.0 weights, tokenizer, reference inference, and tool environments from the undisclosed training, feedback, and safety data.
  • Record Harmony's analysis, commentary, and final channels as a public interface, while keeping their training trace distribution and selection policy unknown.
  • Do not infer a calibrated verifier, reproducible RL algorithm, data license, split, or decontamination result from reported evaluations.

• 将 Model Card 视为披露来源：它证实的是概括性的训练阶段和接口，而不是开放的后训练语料或奖励配方。
  • 将 Apache-2.0 权重、tokenizer、参考推理实现和工具环境，与未公开的训练、反馈和安全数据区分开来。
  • 将 Harmony 的 analysis、commentary 和 final 通道记录为公开接口，同时把其训练轨迹分布和选择策略保持为 unknown。
  • 不要从报告的评估推断出已校准的 verifier、可复现的 RL 算法、数据许可、划分或去污染结果。
